$comment: Tier-2 (real-DB) differential for the Wearable Pool LOADER (P4.D279, keystone C1 §1):
v4 `lib/wardrobe/pool.ts` loadWearablePool / resolveProjectTierForChat / loadCastPools /
componentGraph + `WardrobeRepository.readSharedTiers`, ported to
quilltap_core::wearable_pool + db::wardrobe_read::read_shared_tiers.
ONE committed file drives BOTH sides. build-wearable-pool-fixture.ts bakes a FOUR-tier
world into two DBs (main + mount-index) with the REAL repositories:
1. A user; ADA (a member of The Guild, rostered on the admitting project) and BEA (no
group, the cast-pool contrast) via the REAL repos.characters.create (pinned ids).
2. Quilltap General (an ordinary documents store + the instance_settings pointer).
3. The Guild — REAL repos.groups.create (its official store minted by
ensureOwnerOfficialStore) + Ada's membership through group_character_members.
4. Two projects, `allowAnyCharacter: false` EXPLICITLY: ADMIT (roster [Ada]) and
EXCLUDE (roster []), each with a REAL official store.
5. Chats: one on ADMIT (Ada admitted), one on EXCLUDE (Ada withheld), one with NO
project; a MISSING chat id with no row.
6. Items, all ids pinned, in every tier: General (a topper; the project/General
DUPLICATE id — the project copy wins; a General COMPOSITE whose component is the
GROUP sash — a cross-tier UUID ref kept as written; an ARCHIVED pair of breeches);
ADMIT's store (the duplicate id as `Project badge`; an apron); EXCLUDE's store (a veil);
the group store (the sash; the UNMASK id LIVE as `Guild livery`); Ada's vault (the
UNMASK id ARCHIVED as `My livery` — the archived-before-shadow case; boots; a FILED
gown under `Formal/Evening`); Bea's vault (a coat).
The minted store ids (ADMIT / EXCLUDE / the group) are read back from the owner rows by
the oracle case and carried in its meta row; the Rust test takes them from there.
SAFETY: testPepperBase64 is a THROWAWAY 32-byte key (the one the other wardrobe fixtures
use). NOT a real pepper; safe to commit.
